2608.28371.title: Real-Time Musculoskeletal Surrogates for Pediatric Cerebral Palsy: a Credibility Pilot
2608.28371.paper_summary: Real-time musculoskeletal (MSK) surrogates could support personalized rehabilitation for children with cerebral palsy (CP), but their credibility depends on subject-wise evaluation, low inference latency, and calibrated uncertainty. We develop a subject-conditioned causal neural surrogate using OpenSim-derived static parameters, temporal joint kinematics, true muscle capacities, and training-only perturbations. On a real pediatric CP gait dataset comprising nine children, we use leave-one-subject-out validation on six development subjects and evaluate a frozen configuration once on three locked test subjects. The surrogate accurately reproduces musculotendon lengths (R-square = 0.92 in development validation and approximately 0.95 on locked subjects; nRMSE < 8%) while requiring only sub-millisecond to few-millisecond neural inference, well below a 100 ms interactive-rehabilitation target. In contrast, direct muscle-force estimation remains unstable at this small, heterogeneous scale: pooled metrics can overstate within-subject, per-muscle accuracy. A Monte Carlo credibility pilot further shows that propagating only +/-5% anthropometry and muscle-capacity variation produces severely overconfident nominal 90% intervals (approximately 4% force coverage and below 1% MT-length coverage). These results establish a leakage-free evaluation and credibility framework for pediatric MSK surrogates, while identifying force modeling and epistemic uncertainty as the central next challenges for clinically credible digital twins.
2608.28371.paper_summary_zh: 即時肌肉骨骼 (MSK) 替代品可以支持腦性麻痺 (CP) 兒童的個性化康復，但其可信度取決於受試者的評估、低推斷延遲和經過校準的不確定性。我們使用基於 OpenSim 的靜態參數、時間關節運動學、真實肌肉能力和僅訓練的擾動，開發了一種受試者條件的因果神經替代品。在一個包含九名兒童的實際小兒 CP 步態數據集中，我們對六名發展受試者使用留一受試者驗證，並在三名鎖定測試受試者上評估一次凍結配置。該替代品準確重現了肌腱長度（發展驗證中的 R 平方 = 0.92，鎖定受試者約為 0.95；nRMSE < 8%），同時僅需亞毫秒到幾毫秒的神經推斷，遠低於 100 毫秒的互動康復目標。相比之下，直接的肌肉力量估計在這種小而異質的規模上仍然不穩定：綜合指標可能會高估受試者內的每肌肉準確性。一項蒙特卡羅可信度試點進一步顯示，僅傳播 +/-5% 的人體測量和肌肉能力變化會產生嚴重過度自信的名義 90% 區間（約 4% 的力量覆蓋率和低於 1% 的 MT 長度覆蓋率）。這些結果建立了一個無洩漏的評估和可信度框架，用於小兒 MSK 替代品，同時將力量建模和認知不確定性確定為臨床可信數位雙胞胎的中心挑戰。
2608.28371.author: Mohammad Arif Ul Alam et.al.
